notes: Deploy the new decision version to every instance and confirm it is healthy before starting customer CHG-100. The additive reason field is ignored by old customer versions, while the new customer version must not be exposed to an old decision version. Do not require an atomic cross-service switch. If customer rollout fails, roll customer back first; decision may remain deployed because its extra response field is backward-compatible. If decision rollout fails, roll it back before attempting customer rollout.
